needs: A tree growing: nodes attach one by one as each key walks down from the root.

brief.title: How a binary search tree grows
brief.idea: Each new key in a binary search tree walks down from the root, left when smaller and right when larger, and becomes a leaf where the path runs out.

beats.say: We start with an empty tree and insert fifty. With nothing else there, fifty becomes the root.
beats.show: A single node labelled 50 appears at the top.

beats.say: The rule for every key after it: smaller goes to the left, larger goes to the right.
beats.show: Two branches appear under 50, the left one marked smaller and the right one marked larger.

beats.say: Thirty is smaller than fifty, so it becomes the left child. Seventy is larger, so it goes right.
beats.show: 30 attaches below and to the left of 50, then 70 attaches below and to the right.

beats.say: Twenty is smaller than fifty, then smaller than thirty, so it lands under thirty on the left.
beats.show: A marker travels from 50 to 30, then 20 attaches as the left child of 30.

beats.say: Forty goes left at fifty, then right at thirty. Sixty goes right at fifty, then left at seventy.
beats.show: 40 attaches as the right child of 30, then 60 as the left child of 70.

beats.say: Now insert forty five, and watch only the path it takes.
beats.show: A new key, 45, appears above the root.

beats.say: At fifty it goes left. At thirty it goes right. At forty it goes right again.
beats.show: The marker moves from 50 to 30 to 40, each node it visits lighting up in turn.

beats.say: Forty has no right child, so forty five becomes a new leaf right there, after three comparisons.
beats.show: 45 attaches as the right child of 40, and a counter reads 3 comparisons.

beats.say: Every insert follows one path from the root, and never visits the rest of the tree.
beats.show: The path 50, 30, 40, 45 stays lit while every other node dims.

beats.say: So the work depends on the height of the tree, here four levels, and not on its seven keys.
beats.show: A bracket beside the tree marks its 4 levels next to a count of 7 keys.

beats.say: Keys that arrive already in order build one long chain instead, and every insert walks the whole of it.
beats.show: A second tree built from 10, 20, 30 and 40 leans into a single diagonal chain.
